name: Casteltermini (Italy)
description: Maroon (bordeaux) field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Casteltermini drawn in yellow: an eagle bearing a tower, with the letters M.D.C. beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Casteltermini, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms were recognised by decree of the Head of Government on 2 June 1929.

features.role: eagle bearing a tower, with the letters M.D.C.
